feedback.method: per-tool running hidden-state means; no examples stored

limitations: Public C2-derived data may overlap model pretraining; development results are not an independent held-out exam.
Artifact includes compiler support and loader but excludes runtime libraries; standalone reload must be verified.
Low input-vocabulary coverage maps omitted tokens to fallback; OOV count is reported.
Feedback prototype statistics may need organizer interpretation; evaluation is preliminary.
Per-layer calibration is collected from the original dense trajectory, not sequentially updated.
Timing limit is checked between operators and does not shut down the GPU.
